_comment: Phase 3 (#538): a Spearmen (team 0, WEAPON_SPEAR) vs Infantry (team 1, WEAPON_GLADIUS + SHIELD_SCUTUM) clash, camera eased in past LOD_ZOOM_IN (1.55) so the figure silhouettes are active. Two modest 18-soldier lines spawned well outside either side's melee reach so no instant mass casualties (per the spear-standoff staging lesson), letting the enemy AI march the infantry in on its own -- no scripted steps needed. Shows the spear's forward-tilted rest pose against the shield's raised-guard rest pose (both now read from LoadoutRegistry.default_hold_angle instead of the old single fixed baked angle), then the strike lunge once the front ranks make contact.
